notes.title: Free Update Delayed by COVID-19
notes.notes:
The bad news is our main dev has been out for over three weeks with COVID-19. The good news is he's doing much better, and we have a free update for Conqueror 940 AD coming in October. Originally, the update was planned for August. We are continuing to support Conqueror 940 AD, but the health of our team is our number one priority.

The plans for our upcoming update include new questlines involving the princesses, some significant audiovisual enhancements, and bug fixes. Stay tuned for more!

notes.title: v1.0.8 Research Patch - July 30, 2021
notes.notes:
Overhaul: We changed the formula for Food, Wood, Stone, and Iron income to be more accurate and make more sense in the resource increases.
Fixed: Dialogue where 300 stone was taken from a player without that much stone.
Fixed: Making a kingdom a vassal while they are sending troops to attack you no longer locks up the game.
Fixed: Club bottom price having an extra 0.
Changed: The Sign Post originally reported population incorrectly. Also, buffed research results from 10% to 25%.
Fixed: Building the wood house no longer breaks end-turn button.
Fixed: The Charm skill affects the speed of courting a lady just like kingdom relations now.
Changed: Altered BTR Text for tournaments to be clearer.
Note!: The update is currently PC only. Mac build is coming soon.

notes.title: v1.0.7 Kingdom Patch - July 23, 2021
notes.notes:
Fixed: Player will no longer get repeatedly attacked by the same kingdom every turn.
Fixed: Player getting attacked inconsistently.
Fixed: Player getting blindsided by kingdom attacks.
Updated: Updated dialogue to better reflect what is happening.
Updated: If player has no troops, kingdoms will now raid rather than pillage, making the player lose 25% of their resources rather than 100%.
Updated: Player no longer gets attacked by kingdoms that are a little unhappy. Now they are more likely to attack if they truly do not like you. More than 5 skulls.
Updated: Cleaned up grammar/spelling/inaccuracies issues with researches and building text.

Note!: The update is currently PC only. Mac build is coming soon.

notes.title: Our Forth Weekly Hotfix Update is Now Available!

Our forth weekly hotfix update is now available featuring a more tactical battle system (see notes below), bug fixes, balancing, and more! (Final petition fixes are to come.) Grab it now. Thank you all for your patience and support.

Added: You may now change a research field that is still at 0% progress.
Updated: Population caps are now higher.
Updated: Tax income is now lower.
Updated: When recruiting troops, stronger troops are now shown at the top instead of the bottom.
Fixed: Inaccurate trade adjustments.
Fixed: Trade prices sticking on last selected kingdom.
Fixed: Trade prices changing when switching away from a kingdom and switching back.
Fixed: Stalemates between certain troops.
Fixed: Text size increased for skills and trade tooltips.

notes.title: 3/3/2021 Regular Update & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
3/3/2021 Regular Update & Bug Fixes

We wanted to help new players get acclimated so have added a tutorial. We also added the ability to use troops to defend against raids. Defensive buildings matter to prevent raids but if it happens, use your troops to hold them off. Finally, We did a full rebalance with all researches and building costs. This was to make things less tedious in late game, and a faster pace in the early game. 



NEW CONTENT:
* You can now choose to defend against raids with your troops...or not.
* Added a Tutorial
* Added Raided resource sounds

BUG FIXES:
* Fixed Importing multiple resources were only giving the player the first one (Thanks Nox Solus)
* Changed: Town and Keep Walls, gatehouses, and towers updated

Content Update:

notes.title: Major Update 1: Rabid Wombat
notes.notes:
Major Update 1: Rabid Wombat
* Battle calculations completed redone. Battle will make more sense now.
* Removed Paper/Rock/Scissors format for troop battles
* Added a 'Defense' stat to all troops
* Added animation to barracks UI
* Added Death Scenes for all kingdoms, and they are pretty awesome
* Cleaned up Keeps and made them HD
* Cleaned up troop animations
* Added slider to troop recruitments for faster recruiting
* Stopped scroll bar in barracks from being all bouncy
* Minor bug fixes

Previous changes we snuck into earlier updates but are part of the Rabid Wombat update. 
* Battle strategy hints, we tripled the number of strategy hints during battle to add more variety.
* If you picked up the soundtrack you already have it but this update will add two new great tracks to the game.
* Updated Manpower Gauge
* Taskbar Icon is no longer unity icon
* Added Next/Previous/Loop buttons for soundtrack within the game.
* Reorganization of Barracks UI, separated by troop type and can now click on troops and see each troop card with stats and more details.
* Added a slider to barracks troops to make it easier to recruit a lot of troops at once.
* Added ingame encyclopedia / manual
